en: Abu al-Hasan Thabit ibn Qurra al-Harrani
ar: أبو الحسن ثابت بن قرة الحراني

description.tr: Beytü'l-Hikme'nin en büyük matematikçi-çevirmeni olan Sâbiî yıldız tapıcısı. Arapça Arşimet ve Apollonios'u kurtararak Yunan matematiğini korudu || Sâbit, Harran'dan bir Sâbiî'ydi — Beytü'l-Hikme'nin dini çoğulculuğunun canlı kanıtı. || [Tarih notu] Rosenfeld ve Grigorian (1993) Sâbit hanedanının üç kuşaklık ilmi üretimini belgeledi.
description.en: Sabian star-worshipper who became the greatest mathematician-translator of the House of Wisdom. His Arabic Archimedes and Apollonius saved irreplaceable Greek mathematics. Extended Pythagorean theorem to general triangles || Thabit was a Sabian (star-worshipper) from Harran — living proof of the House of Wisdom's religious pluralism. He translated Archimedes' works that survive only in his Arabic, extended the Pythagorean theorem, and founded a family dynasty of scholars spanning three generations. || [Historiographical note] Rosenfeld and Grigorian (1993) documented the Thabit dynasty's three-generation scholarly output. Sabra (1968) established the mathematical originality beyond translation.
description.ar: صابئي عابد نجوم أصبح أعظم مترجم-رياضي في بيت الحكمة. حفظ رياضيات يونانية لا تُعوَّض || كان ثابت صابئيًا من حرّان — دليل حي على التعددية الدينية في بيت الحكمة. ترجم أعمال أرخميدس التي لا تبقى إلا بالعربية
